overlaps.rationale: Cash is physical money in notes or coins; cash deposit is the act of paying that money into an account.
Savings is money kept for future use; cash deposit is a specific account-funding transaction.
Withdrawal removes money from an account, whereas cash deposit puts cash into an account.
Bank transfer moves money between accounts; cash deposit specifically pays physical cash into an account.
Bank account is the account itself; cash deposit is a transaction made into that account.
